caption: The drawing features a single wooden armchair placed centrally against a plain, lightly yellowed background. The chair has a dark brown seat, possibly upholstered, and a medium brown wooden frame with a high, curved backrest that includes a decorative cut-out central splat. The arms of the chair are rounded and curve outward, connecting to the straight front legs and slightly tapered back legs. Supporting the structure, there are horizontal wooden stretchers connecting the legs on all sides. The illustration is rendered with a focus on natural wood grain texture and moderate shading to suggest depth. There are no other objects or decorations in the composition, and the overall appearance is clean and uncluttered.
title: Armchair
